author: codex-ai-root
exposure: The first independent reviewer fixed six raw reports before consulting catalog proposal IDs/geometries. Root started from all raw contacts, PRQ quadrants, berth detail and unknown candidates with prior knowledge of the independent reference counts but before proposal correspondence; the raw pass is separately hash-pinned. Root then inspected all candidate and scope renders, correspondence counts and the three final derived scope renders. The final adjudication is not model-blind and is not human ground truth. No scores were used to draw or modify reference boxes; no phase2 performance metrics have been computed.
decisions: Accept the 17 PRQ raw anchorage references and their unchanged visual boxes; corresponding existing proposal geometries are corrected to the visual references.

Accept three PBR berth hulls visible through haze in the raw RGB detail. Their manually reviewed positive windows are intentional visual extensions of automatic observability; automatic quality masks remain unchanged. This may count as model misses in calibration, not an excuse to remove references.

Accept PRQ V26 in the inner basin and V27 alongside the eastern quay. V27 was identified in the second raw visual pass, documented by separate addendum with January visual context, not added on the basis of metrics. The visual context establishes neither identity nor a physical change claim.
Accept only the small explicit water strip at STCfondeo Oct9; remove the forest peninsula from supervision. The active provisional AOI is unchanged. The STC bright point/wake remains unknown.
Normalize the negligible PRQpatios area to abstention. Preserve ambiguous pier interfaces and small unresolved responses outside reviewed areas; do not assert zero vessels outside those areas.
Keep all first-date cloudy observations as reviewed abstentions. The separately documented chronological reserve does not erase these attempts.
Preserve family, length and width as null. This cohort is below the fixed calibration support minimum and establishes no precision claim.
